A neural net that learns \"priors over f.zh: 一种像高斯过程那样学习「函数先验」的神经网络 —— 只不过它是摊销式的。点击若干上下文点；一个条件神经网络过程（CNP）会预测其余部分，其不确定性在数据缺失处张得更开。可与在同一上下文上拟合的真实 GP 作比较。
A neural net that learns \"priors over f.src:
A neural net that learns "priors over functions" the way a
          Gaussian process does — but amortised. Click context
          points; a Conditional Neural Process predicts the rest with
          uncertainty that bows out where data is missing. Compare to
          a real GP fit on the same context.

@@T0@@~20 min@@T1@@\n @@T2@@Pro.zh:
@@T0@@约 20 分钟@@T1@@
          @@T2@@概率 · 元学习 · 不确定性@@T3@@

What problem does an NP solve?.zh: NP 解决的是什么问题？
What problem does an NP solve?.src: What problem does an NP solve?

You have a small @@T0@@context@@T1@@ set.zh: 你手头有一小批 $(x, y)$ 对构成的@@T0@@上下文@@T1@@集，希望在新 $x$ 处预测 $y$ 并给出不确定性。高斯过程借助核函数做到这一点。神经网络过程则用一个学习得到的编码器 / 解码器取代核函数，并把推断@@T2@@摊销@@T3@@化：在测试时只需一次前向传播 —— 无需优化，也无需做核矩阵求逆。
You have a small @@T0@@context@@T1@@ set.src: You have a small context set of $(x, y)$ pairs and you want to predict $y$ at new $x$ values, with uncertainty. A Gaussian process does this with a kernel. A neural process replaces the kernel with a learned encoder/decoder, then amortises inference: at test time it's a single forward pass — no optimisation, no kernel-matrix inversion.

@@T0@@GP.@@T1@@ Beautiful uncertainty, b.zh: @@T0@@GP。@@T1@@ 不确定性刻画优美，但复杂度为上下文规模的 $O(N^3)$，而且你必须选取一个核函数。
@@T0@@GP.@@T1@@ Beautiful uncertainty, b.src: GP. Beautiful uncertainty, but $O(N^3)$ in the context size and you have to pick a kernel.

@@T0@@NP.@@T1@@ Cheap to evaluate, no ke.zh: @@T0@@NP。@@T1@@ 评估代价低，无需选择核函数。但你必须先在一个相关任务的分布上训练它。
@@T0@@NP.@@T1@@ Cheap to evaluate, no ke.src: NP. Cheap to evaluate, no kernel choice. But you must train it on a distribution of related tasks first.

@@T0@@The slogan.@@T1@@ An NP is a meta-.zh: @@T0@@一句话口号。@@T1@@ NP 是 GP 的一个元学习代理模型。你为众多函数支付一次性的训练成本；此后每一次预测都只是一次前向传播。
@@T0@@The slogan.@@T1@@ An NP is a meta-.src: The slogan. An NP is a meta-learned surrogate for a GP. You pay a one-time training cost over many functions; thereafter every prediction is one forward pass.

Architecture: encoder → aggregate → deco.zh: 架构：编码器 → 聚合 → 解码器

The Conditional Neural Process (Garnelo.zh: 条件神经网络过程（Garnelo 等，2018）：

$h$ is a small MLP that turns each conte.zh: $h$ 是一个小型 MLP，把每个上下文对 $(x_i, y_i)$ 转换为表示 $r_i$。聚合器是一种置换不变的池化（均值），把它们聚成一个表示 $r$。解码器 $g$ 把 $(x_*, r)$ 映射为任意查询 $x_*$ 处的预测均值与方差。
$h$ is a small MLP that turns each conte.src:
$h$ is a small MLP that turns each context pair $(x_i, y_i)$
          into a representation $r_i$. The aggregator is a
          permutation-invariant pooling (mean) into a single
          representation $r$. The decoder $g$ maps $(x_*, r)$ to the
          predicted mean and variance at any query $x_*$.

The CNP pipeline. Mean-pooling makes the.zh: CNP 流水线。均值池化使模型对上下文集合具有置换不变性。
The CNP pipeline. Mean-pooling makes the.src: The CNP pipeline. Mean-pooling makes the model permutation-invariant in the context set.

Try it: click points, see the posterior.zh: 动手试试：点击数据点，观察后验
Try it: click points, see the posterior.src: Try it: click points, see the posterior

Click anywhere on the canvas to add a co.zh: 在画布上任意位置点击即可添加一个上下文点。右键点击（或按住 Shift 点击）删除。该模型已在一族光滑函数上预训练；它不会随你的点击而训练 —— 每增加一个点，它只执行一次前向传播。作为对照，同时展示在同一上下文上拟合的 GP。
Click anywhere on the canvas to add a co.src:
Click anywhere on the canvas to add a context point.
          Right-click (or shift-click) to remove. The model is
          pre-trained on a family of smooth functions; it's not
          training as you click — it just runs a single forward
          pass per point. The GP fit on the same context is shown for
          comparison.

Neural Process posterior (mean ± 2σ).zh: 神经网络过程后验（均值 ± 2σ）

GP posterior on same context (RBF).zh: 同一上下文上的 GP 后验（RBF）

@@T0@@What to watch for.@@T1@@\n.zh:
@@T0@@应当留意之处。@@T1@@
          当上下文点为 0 时，NP 返回其训练族群的先验均值（通常大致为零）并给出很宽的带；GP 则返回其先验。添加几个点后，二者的带都会在局部收窄。在远离数据之处，NP 的带@@T2@@形状@@T3@@略有不同 —— NP 已从它所训练的族群中学到了哪些类型的函数更可能出现（光滑性、周期性）；而 GP 只知道自己的核超参数。
@@T0@@What to watch for.@@T1@@\n.src: What to watch for. With 0 context points, the NP returns the prior mean of its training family (often roughly zero) with a wide band; the GP returns its prior. Add a few points and both shrink the band locally. The NP's band has a slightly different shape away from the data — the NP has learned what kinds of functions are likely (smoothness, periodicity) from the family it was trained on; the GP only knows its kernel hyperparameters.

The training objective — meta-learning,.zh: 训练目标 —— 从形式上看元学习

NPs are trained by @@T0@@meta-learning@@.zh: NP 通过@@T0@@元学习@@T1@@来训练：模拟许多小型数据集，并要求 NP 在每个数据集内部预测被留出的点。对于上下文为 $\mathcal{C} = \{(x_i, y_i)\}$、目标为 $\mathcal{T} = \{(x_j, y_j)\}$ 的单个任务，确定性的 CNP 最小化
NPs are trained by @@T0@@meta-learning@@.src: NPs are trained by meta-learning: simulate many small datasets and ask the NP to predict held-out points within each. For one task with context $\mathcal{C} = \{(x_i, y_i)\}$ and target $\mathcal{T} = \{(x_j, y_j)\}$ the deterministic CNP minimises

where $\\mu, \\sigma^2$ come from the de.zh: 其中 $\mu, \sigma^2$ 来自以聚合表示为条件的解码器 $r_\mathcal{C}$。该期望是对从任务分布中采样的众多 $(\mathcal{C}, \mathcal{T})$ 对求取的。
where $\\mu, \\sigma^2$ come from the de.src: where $\mu, \sigma^2$ come from the decoder conditioned on the aggregated representation $r_\mathcal{C}$. The expectation is over many sampled $(\mathcal{C}, \mathcal{T})$ pairs from a task distribution.

The @@T0@@Latent NP@@T1@@ introduces a g.zh: @@T0@@潜变量 NP@@T1@@ 引入一个全局潜变量 $z$，并使用 ELBO：
The @@T0@@Latent NP@@T1@@ introduces a g.src: The Latent NP introduces a global latent $z$ and uses an ELBO:

$q(z|\\mathcal{C} \\cup \\mathcal{T})$ i.zh: $q(z|\mathcal{C} \cup \mathcal{T})$ 是变分后验（在上下文 + 目标上的编码器）；$p(z|\mathcal{C})$ 是先验（仅在上下文上的编码器）。采样 $z$ 可在各查询之间得到相互一致的函数样本——即像 GP 那样抽取整条函数。CNP 是其退化情形，此时 $z$ 坍缩为一个点估计。
$q(z|\\mathcal{C} \\cup \\mathcal{T})$ i.src: $q(z|\mathcal{C} \cup \mathcal{T})$ is the variational posterior (encoder over context + target); $p(z|\mathcal{C})$ is the prior (encoder over context only). Sampling $z$ gives function-consistent samples across queries — drawing whole functions, like a GP. The CNP is the degenerate case where $z$ collapses to a point estimate.

The variants and what each adds.zh: 各变体及其各自的增益
The variants and what each adds.src: The variants and what each adds

@@T0@@CNP.@@T1@@ Deterministic. Predicts.zh: @@T0@@CNP。@@T1@@ 确定性。对每个查询预测均值 + 方差。代价低，单次前向传播。无法采样出整条一致的函数。
@@T0@@CNP.@@T1@@ Deterministic. Predicts.src: CNP. Deterministic. Predicts mean + variance per query. Cheap, single forward pass. Cannot sample whole consistent functions.

@@T0@@Latent NP (LNP).@@T1@@ Adds a stoc.zh: @@T0@@潜变量 NP（LNP）。@@T1@@ 增加一个概括整条函数的随机潜变量 $z$。采样一次 $z$，解码多次查询 —— 你就得到一条连贯的函数样本，如同 GP 的一次抽样。代价是要面对更紧的 ELBO 损失与更难的训练。
@@T0@@Latent NP (LNP).@@T1@@ Adds a stoc.src: Latent NP (LNP). Adds a stochastic latent $z$ that summarises the function. Sample $z$ once, decode many queries — you get a coherent function sample, like a GP draw. Pays for it in a tighter ELBO loss and harder training.

@@T0@@Attentive NP (ANP).@@T1@@ Replaces.zh: @@T0@@注意力 NP（ANP）。@@T1@@ 用从查询到上下文的注意力取代均值聚合。GP 那种类似核函数的行为重新出现：每个查询都会检索最相关的上下文点。对许多任务而言是两全其美之选。
@@T0@@Attentive NP (ANP).@@T1@@ Replaces.src: Attentive NP (ANP). Replaces mean aggregation with attention from query to context. The kernel-like behaviour of GPs reappears: each query looks up the most relevant context points. Best of both worlds for many tasks.

@@T0@@Convolutional NP (ConvNP).@@T1@@ U.zh: @@T0@@卷积 NP（ConvNP）。@@T1@@ 当输入是一维信号 / 时间序列时使用卷积编码器 —— 尊重平移等变性。在传感器 / 气候数据上表现强劲。
@@T0@@Convolutional NP (ConvNP).@@T1@@ U.src: Convolutional NP (ConvNP). Uses a convolutional encoder when the input is a 1-D signal / time-series — respects translation equivariance. Strong on sensor / climate data.

@@T0@@Transformer NP / NP with attention.zh: @@T0@@Transformer NP / 仅含注意力的 NP（NeuralProcessFamily）。@@T1@@ 现代变体倾向于去掉显式的聚合器，转而对（上下文 ⊕ 查询）词元使用 Transformer。
@@T0@@Transformer NP / NP with attention.src: Transformer NP / NP with attention only (NeuralProcessFamily). Modern variants tend to drop the explicit aggregator and use a transformer over (context ⊕ query) tokens.

When to reach for an NP vs a GP.zh: 何时选用 NP，何时选用 GP
When to reach for an NP vs a GP.src: When to reach for an NP vs a GP

@@T0@@Many similar tasks, each with litt.zh:
@@T0@@大量相似任务，且每个任务数据很少。@@T1@@
            逐个传感器的校准、逐位患者的个性化、逐幅图像的小样本回归。NP 在此大放异彩：在整个族群上训练一次；对下一个实例的预测只需毫秒级。
@@T0@@Many similar tasks, each with litt.src: Many similar tasks, each with little data. Per-sensor calibration, per-patient personalisation, per-image few-shot regression. NPs shine: train once across the family; predict on the next instance in milliseconds.

@@T0@@One task with a lot of data.@@T1@@.zh: @@T0@@单一任务但数据很多。@@T1@@ 使用带诱导点的 GP（SVGP），或在 $N \le 10^4$ 时使用精确 GP，通常优于 NP。NP 的摊销优势便不复存在。
@@T0@@One task with a lot of data.@@T1@@.src: One task with a lot of data. A GP with inducing points (SVGP) or an exact GP if $N \le 10^4$ usually beats an NP. The NP's amortisation premium disappears.

@@T0@@Online streaming.@@T1@@ NPs handle.zh: @@T0@@在线流式场景。@@T1@@ NP 天然地处理「上下文随时间增长」，因为每次预测都是一次前向传播。而 GP 需要重新拟合（或采用在线更新）。
@@T0@@Online streaming.@@T1@@ NPs handle.src: Online streaming. NPs handle "context grows over time" naturally because each prediction is a forward pass. GPs need to refit (or use online updates).

@@T0@@Image / 2-D completion.@@T1@@ Cond.zh: @@T0@@图像 / 二维补全。@@T1@@ 条件 NP 变体只需一次前向传播，即可从 $k$ 个像素补全出整幅 CelebA 图像——在这个用例中，在图像上的元训练分布是自然而然的选择。
@@T0@@Image / 2-D completion.@@T1@@ Cond.src: Image / 2-D completion. Conditional-NP variants do CelebA image completion with one forward pass from $k$ pixels to the full image — a use case where the meta-training distribution over images is natural.

@@T0@@Bayesian optimisation.@@T1@@ Trans.zh: @@T0@@贝叶斯优化。@@T1@@ Transformer 神经网络过程（TNP）可作为 BO 的有力代理模型，具有同类的摊销特性：在一族目标函数上训练一次，部署时无需针对每个目标函数拟合超参数。
@@T0@@Bayesian optimisation.@@T1@@ Trans.src: Bayesian optimisation. Transformer Neural Processes (TNP) are competitive surrogates for BO, with the same kind of amortisation: train once on a family of objective functions, deploy without per-objective hyperparameter fitting.

@@T0@@Final takeaway.@@T1@@\n N.zh:
@@T0@@最终要点。@@T1@@
          神经网络过程就是被摊销化的 GP。如果你有大量彼此相关的小任务，并希望得到快速且不确定性经过校准的预测，它们就是正确的工具。如果你只有单一的大任务，并想要清晰的概率语义，那么 GP（或深度核学习）仍然胜出。
@@T0@@Final takeaway.@@T1@@\n N.src: Final takeaway. Neural processes are GPs amortised. If you have many small related tasks and want fast predictions with calibrated uncertainty, they are the right tool. If you have a single big task and want crisp probabilistic semantics, a GP (or deep kernel learning) still wins.

Failure modes and how to spot them.src: Failure modes and how to spot them

@@T0@@Underconfidence.@@T1@@ CNPs traine.zh: @@T0@@过度保守（置信不足）。@@T1@@ 以高斯似然训练的 CNP 往往给出过宽的区间——模型是在针对元训练分布做对冲。可用可靠性图来诊断；通过注意力（ANP）、更具表现力的似然，或事后校准来修正。
@@T0@@Underconfidence.@@T1@@ CNPs traine.src: Underconfidence. CNPs trained with Gaussian likelihood often produce too-wide intervals — the model hedges against the meta-train distribution. Diagnose with reliability diagrams; fix with attention (ANP), more expressive likelihoods, or post-hoc calibration.

@@T0@@Posterior collapse in LNPs.@@T1@@.zh: @@T0@@LNP 中的后验坍缩。@@T1@@ 若解码器过强，潜变量 $z$ 会变得无信息量，LNP 便退化为 CNP。可用 $\beta$-VAE 式的退火或 free-bits 来修正。
@@T0@@Posterior collapse in LNPs.@@T1@@.src: Posterior collapse in LNPs. If the decoder is too strong, the latent $z$ becomes uninformative and the LNP degenerates to a CNP. Fix with $\beta$-VAE-style annealing or free-bits.

@@T0@@Out-of-distribution context.@@T1@@.zh: @@T0@@分布外的上下文。@@T1@@ 如果测试上下文来自元训练中未曾见过的函数族群，NP 的外推会很糟糕。真正的 GP 只会把它的带拉宽；而 NP 却可能自信地给出一个错误答案。
@@T0@@Out-of-distribution context.@@T1@@.src: Out-of-distribution context. If the test context comes from a function family not seen in meta-training, the NP extrapolates badly. A real GP would just widen its bands; the NP can confidently make up a wrong answer.

@@T0@@Permutation invariance break.@@T1@.zh: @@T0@@置换不变性被破坏。@@T1@@ 务必确保聚合器（均值 / 注意力）真正具有置换不变性。一个值得检查的隐蔽缺陷：打乱上下文的顺序，检验预测结果是否逐位完全相同。
@@T0@@Permutation invariance break.@@T1@.src: Permutation invariance break. Make sure the aggregator (mean / attention) is truly permutation-invariant. A subtle bug to test for: shuffle context order and check the prediction is bit-identical.

@@T0@@Bruinsma et&nbsp;al. (2023)@@T1@@.zh: @@T0@@Bruinsma 等（2023）@@T1@@ —— @@T2@@The Neural Process Family@@T3@@ 教科书章节；标准的教学参考。
@@T0@@Bruinsma et&nbsp;al. (2023)@@T1@@.src: Bruinsma et al. (2023) — The Neural Process Family textbook chapter; the standard pedagogical reference.

meta.title: 神经网络过程实战
meta.tagline: 一种像高斯过程那样学习「函数先验」的神经网络——只不过是摊销式的
meta.summary: 在一维坐标轴上点击上下文点，一个条件神经网络过程便会预测其余部分，其不确定性带在数据缺失处张得更开——恰如 GP，只不过核函数被换成了一个学习得到的编码器。可将 CNP 与在同一上下文上拟合的真实 GP 作比较，看看潜变量（LNP）与注意力（ANP）变体各自带来什么增益。本实验面向带小型校准集的传感器回归。
highlights: 在一维坐标轴上点击上下文点；预训练的 CNP 与 GP 并排实时预测其余部分。
手工调定 CNP 权重，使演示无需自动求导库即可运行，并另设一个面板展示编码器→聚合→解码器流水线。
在 CNP、潜变量 NP（采样整条函数）与注意力变体（对上下文施加类核的注意力）之间切换。
各变体各自的优势所在，以及面向小样本传感器 / 热学回归的实验应用。
